title: Spicy Irish Beef Fajitas
description: A twist on traditional Mexican fajitas, using Irish beef and a spicy kick. Serve with warm flour tortillas and your favorite toppings.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of peppery stir-fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add Irish beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.
Add remaining 1 tablespoon of peppery stir-fry oil to the skillet. Add peppers and onions and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add fajita seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add cooked Irish beef strips back into the skillet and stir to combine.
Optional: Add chopped dates and stir to combine.
Warm flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble fajitas by placing beef and pepper mixture onto tortillas and topping with chopped cilantro (if using).
